A [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] '''group''' operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Edly Fasalk]] was a member of the group, until he was abandoned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] because the rest of privateers became tired of his constant tall tales.
